max_call_duration.label: Max call duration (s)
max_call_duration.description: Hang up when the call reaches this duration

idle_timeout.label: Idle timeout (s)
idle_timeout.description: How long to wait after the user stays silent before the agent checks if they are still there

max_idle_messages.label: Max idle messages
max_idle_messages.description: Maximum times the agent can check if the user is still there during the call

silence_timeout.label: Silence timeout (s)
silence_timeout.description: End the call if the user stays silent for more than this duration

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.description: Controls randomness. Lower values are more deterministic, higher values more creative

reasoning_effort.label: Reasoning effort
reasoning_effort.description: How long the model thinks before it answers

max_tokens.label: Max tokens
max_tokens.description: Max tokens the agent can generate in each turn of the conversation

tool_choice.label: Tool choice
tool_choice.description: Auto decides, None disables tools, Required always calls one

preemptive_generation.label: Preemptive generation
preemptive_generation.description: Start generating a reply before the user's turn is confirmed

preemptive_tts.label: Preemptive TTS
preemptive_tts.description: Also synthesize speech before the turn is confirmed

max_speech_duration.label: Max speech duration (ms)
max_speech_duration.description: Skip early generation if the user has already been speaking longer than this

max_retries.label: Max retries
max_retries.description: Maximum early-generation attempts for one turn

keyterms.label: Keyterms
keyterms.description: Boost recognition of names, jargon, and product terms

intelligent_turn_taking.label: Intelligent turn taking
intelligent_turn_taking.description: On, the transcriber decides when the user finished. Off, the agent waits a fixed silence delay instead

min_end_of_turn_wait.label: Min end of turn wait (ms)
min_end_of_turn_wait.description: How long to wait after the user stops speaking before the agent can respond

max_end_of_turn_wait.label: Max end of turn wait (ms)
max_end_of_turn_wait.description: Longest the agent waits after the user stops speaking before ending the turn

endpointing_mode.label: Endpointing mode
endpointing_mode.description: Fixed uses the min and max delays, dynamic adapts within that range from pause statistics

endpointing_alpha.label: Endpointing alpha
endpointing_alpha.description: Weight of past pauses in dynamic endpointing. Higher adapts more slowly

silence_timeout.label: Silence timeout (ms)
silence_timeout.description: Silence before this transcriber treats the turn as complete

vad_threshold.label: VAD threshold
vad_threshold.description: How sensitive voice detection is. Higher ignores more background noise

eager_end_of_turn_threshold.label: Eager end-of-turn threshold
eager_end_of_turn_threshold.description: Confidence required to signal an early end of turn

end_of_turn_threshold.label: End-of-turn threshold
end_of_turn_threshold.description: Confidence needed before the transcriber closes the user's turn

end_of_turn_timeout.label: End-of-turn timeout (ms)
end_of_turn_timeout.description: Silence that ends the turn even if confidence is still low

min_turn_silence.label: Min turn silence (ms)
min_turn_silence.description: Silence before the model checks whether the turn has ended

max_turn_silence.label: Max turn silence (ms)
max_turn_silence.description: Silence that forces the turn to end

end_of_turn_confidence.label: End-of-turn confidence
end_of_turn_confidence.description: How sure the transcriber must be that the user is done

endpoint_latency_level.label: Endpoint latency level
endpoint_latency_level.description: 0 is default semantic endpointing, 3 is most aggressive

min_eot_silence_when_confident.label: Min EOT silence when confident (ms)
min_eot_silence_when_confident.description: Shortest silence required to end a turn when the model is already confident

smart_turn.label: Smart turn
smart_turn.description: Confidence required before smart turn detection ends the user's turn

smart_turn_timeout.label: Smart turn timeout (ms)
smart_turn_timeout.description: How long smart turn detection waits before ending the turn

voice_focus.label: Voice focus
voice_focus.description: Tune recognition for a close or distant microphone

voice_focus_threshold.label: Voice focus threshold
voice_focus_threshold.description: How aggressively background audio is suppressed. Higher is stronger

voice_profile.label: Voice profile
voice_profile.description: Bias recognition toward a saved speaker profile

voice_profile_top_n.label: Voice profile top N
voice_profile_top_n.description: How many speaker profiles to match against

diarization.label: Diarization
diarization.description: Label distinct speakers in the transcript

strict_language.label: Strict language
strict_language.description: Prefer transcription in the selected language

agent_context_carryover.label: Agent context carryover
agent_context_carryover.description: Bias the next transcription with what the agent just said

mip_opt_out.label: MIP opt-out
mip_opt_out.description: Opt out of using this audio to improve the provider's models

language.description: Recognition is optimized for this language

speed.label: Speed
speed.description: Speaking rate multiplier. 1 is normal pace

latency_mode.label: Latency mode
latency_mode.description: Normal is highest quality, low is fastest

interruptions.label: Interruptions
interruptions.description: Stop the agent when the user starts speaking

discard_uninterruptible_audio.label: Discard uninterruptible audio
discard_uninterruptible_audio.description: Drop buffered audio while the agent is speaking and cannot be interrupted

min_interruption_duration.label: Min interruption duration (ms)
min_interruption_duration.description: How long the user must speak before the agent stops talking

min_interruption_words.label: Min interruption words
min_interruption_words.description: How many words the user must say before the agent stops talking

false_interruption_timeout.label: False interruption timeout (ms)
false_interruption_timeout.description: How long to wait with no transcript before an interruption counts as false

resume_after_false_interruption.label: Resume after false interruption
resume_after_false_interruption.description: Resume the agent's speech from where it left off after a false interruption

tts_volume.label: TTS volume
tts_volume.description: Loudness adjustment in decibels. 0 leaves the voice unchanged

emotion.label: Emotion
emotion.description: Emotional tone of the speech, one tag per line

mip_opt_out.label: MIP opt-out
mip_opt_out.description: Opt out of using this audio to improve the provider's models
